name: print-social-lifestyle-phone-scrolling-friends-photo
title: Candid outdoor photo of two friends absorbed in their phones
whatItIs: A naturally lit outdoor photo of two young women standing side by side, both looking down at their phones, shot with a shallow depth of field against a blurred street backdrop.
whatItMeans: Two people standing together but each absorbed in their own phone visually communicates 'digital disconnection,' a common metaphor in social-wellbeing and phone-habit content.
techniques: position two subjects physically close but visually isolated (each looking at their own device) to imply disconnection
use natural outdoor light and shallow depth of field for an authentic, unstaged feel
let ambient background details blur softly so the subjects and their phones stay the clear focus

vocabulary.definition: a photographic technique keeping the subject sharp while the background blurs, achieved with a wide aperture
